issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Heard
products.tagline: Give Claude Code and Codex a voice
products.summaryZh: 为Claude Code和Codex赋予声音。
products.descriptionZh: Heard 是 macOS 上的语音层，适用于你的智能体工作流。它能连接 Claude Code、Codex 和 Cursor，并将其输出转化为可收听的智能摘要。当你视线离开时提供完整解说，或保持静默直到出现错误或需要决策。当多个智能体并行运行时，Heard 会在项目层面进行总结，让你听到工作进展，而非五个终端互相干扰。配对手机后，它能随你移动。开源，个人使用免费。
products.description: Heard is a macOS voice layer for your agentic workflows. It connects to Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor and turns their output into intelligent summaries you can hear. Full commentary when your eyes are elsewhere, or silence until something errors or needs a decision. With agents run in parallel, Heard summarizes at the project level, so you hear where the work stands, not five terminals talking over each other. Pair your phone and it comes with you. Open source, free for personal use.

products.name: FluentDB
products.tagline: The AI database client for Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 上的 AI 数据库客户端
products.descriptionZh: FluentDB 是一款面向 macOS 的 AI 驱动数据库客户端。它支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite、SQL Server，更多数据库支持即将推出。该工具以速度、简洁和安全为设计理念，可通过您自己的 API 密钥或 Claude Code/Codex 订阅与 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 配合使用，也可通过 Ollama 使用本地模型。未经您的许可，您的数据不会离开您的设备：模型仅查看您的数据库结构，而非实际数据，且所有 AI 生成的 SQL 查询默认需要经过您的批准。
products.description: FluentDB is an AI-powered database client for macOS. It supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, with more coming soon. Built for speed, simplicity, and security, it works with Anthropic and OpenAI using your own API keys or Claude Code/Codex subscriptions, and with local models via Ollama. Your data never leaves your machine without your approval: models see your schema, not your data, and every AI-generated SQL query requires approval by default.

products.name: Second Brain for Mac and Windows
products.tagline: Your AI memory, everywhere you work
products.summaryZh: 你的AI记忆，伴随你工作的每一处
products.descriptionZh: Second Brain桌面应用五分钟即可上手。无需终端，无需Git。只需下载、设置密码、登录Cloudflare，真正的魔法便随之开启：所有AI工具间的持久记忆；更智能的回忆功能，精准呈现相关记忆而非最新记录；自动构建的知识图谱；数据存储于你的Cloudflare账户而非我们手中。支持Mac与Windows系统。你期待的应用，你渴望的更好回忆——我们一并交付。
products.description: The Second Brain desktop app gets you running in five minutes. No terminal. No git. Just download, set a password, and sign into Cloudflare. Then the real magic starts. Persistent memory across every AI tool you use. Recall that just got a lot smarter. Surfaces the right memory, not just the newest one. A knowledge graph that builds itself. Your data in your own Cloudflare account, not ours. Mac and Windows. You asked for the app. You asked for better recall. We shipped both.

products.name: OpenComputer
products.tagline: The easiest way to deploy a managed agent.
products.summaryZh: 部署托管代理的最简单方式。
products.descriptionZh: 部署托管代理的最简单方式。只需描述代理应执行的任务，将一条提示粘贴到你的编码代理中，即可获得一个实时代理链接。
products.description: The easiest way to deploy a managed agent. Say what your agent should do, paste one prompt into your coding agent, get a live agent URL.

products.name: Capsomnia
products.tagline: Caps Lock keeps your Mac awake, even with the lid closed
products.summaryZh: Caps Lock 能让你的 Mac 保持唤醒状态，即使合上盖子也不例外。
products.descriptionZh: Capsomnia 将 Caps Lock 键变为物理开关，让 MacBook 保持唤醒状态。合上屏幕后，仍可继续运行 Claude Code、Codex、其他 AI 代理、SSH 会话、构建、下载等任务。若 Caps Lock 已被占用，可选择其他快捷键。Caps Lock 指示灯仍会显示 Capsomnia 是否处于激活状态。该应用免费且开源，已签名并公证。无需账户或遥测。在日本已获得强烈关注：超过 230 万次浏览和 6000 多次下载。
products.description: Capsomnia turns Caps Lock into a physical switch that keeps your MacBook awake. Keep Claude Code, Codex, other AI agents, SSH sessions, builds, downloads, and more running after you close the lid. If Caps Lock is already assigned, choose another shortcut. The Caps Lock light still shows whether Capsomnia is active. The app is free and open source, signed and notarized. No accounts or telemetry. We’ve already seen strong interest in Japan: 2.3M+ views and 6,000+ downloads.

products.name: Health in ChatGPT
products.tagline: Your personal health companion, powered by ChatGPT
products.summaryZh: 你的个人健康助手，由ChatGPT驱动
products.descriptionZh: ChatGPT 中的健康功能将您的健康信息整合到一次对话中，帮助您更好地了解和掌控自身健康。连接您的健康数据、医疗记录和健康应用，即可获得更个性化的洞察、追踪长期变化、为就诊做准备、理解检查结果，并建立更健康的生活习惯——同时您始终掌握分享内容的控制权。
products.description: Health in ChatGPT helps you better understand and navigate your health by bringing your health information into one conversation. Connect your health data, medical records, and wellness apps to get more personalized insights, track changes over time, prepare for appointments, understand results, and build healthier routines — all while staying in control of what you share.

products.name: Islet
products.tagline: iPhone's Dynamic Island, brought to your Mac's notch
products.summaryZh: iPhone 的灵动岛，现已融入 Mac 的刘海。
products.descriptionZh: 大多数刘海工具只是在屏幕缺口上绘制一个静态形状。Islet 则真正模拟了 iPhone 的灵动岛：原生弹簧物理效果的展开/折叠动画、音量与亮度的实时 HUD、带完整播放控制的音乐实时预览、一键切换音频输出（无需绕道系统设置），以及日历、天气和可从任意位置拖入的文件托盘。基于 Swift + AppKit 原生构建（非 Electron），运行流畅且支持全屏感知。
products.description: Most notch utilities just draw a static shape over the cutout. Islet actually behaves like iPhone's Dynamic Island: native spring-physics expand/collapse, real-time HUDs for volume and brightness, a live music glance with full playback controls, one-tap audio output switching (no System Settings detour), plus calendar, weather, and a file tray you can drop into from anywhere. Built natively in Swift + AppKit, not Electron, fast and fullscreen-aware.

products.name: Speechius
products.tagline: The teleprompter that actually listens
products.summaryZh: 真正会倾听的提词器
products.descriptionZh: Speechius 聆听你的声音，自动滚动你的脚本——加速、减速、脱离脚本，它都能跟上节奏。无需脚踏板，无需追赶固定速度。它可在任何工具中实时运行——真实网络研讨会、Zoom、Meet、Teams、OBS——并在屏幕共享时保持隐藏。完全在设备端运行（保护隐私）。一次性付费，无需订阅。支持 macOS 和 Windows。
products.description: Speechius listens to your voice and scrolls your script for you - speed up, slow down, go off-script, it keeps pace. No foot pedal, no fixed speed to chase. It works live in any tool - real webinars, Zoom, Meet, Teams, OBS - and stays hidden on screen-share. Fully on-device (private). One-time price, no subscription. macOS & Windows.

products.name: Wisprkey
products.tagline: Talk to any app on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 与Mac上的任何应用对话
products.descriptionZh: Wisprkey 是一款免费的 Mac 语音输入应用。可设置全局快捷键，准确率 98%，支持 31 种语言。
products.description: Wisprkey is a free Mac app for voice typing. Set a global shortcut, 98% accuracy, 31 languages.

products.name: ShellMate
products.tagline: The SSH workspace you'll actually enjoy using
products.summaryZh: 你会真正喜欢使用的SSH工作空间
products.descriptionZh: ShellMate 是一款为开发者、系统管理员和 DevOps 团队打造的现代化 SSH 工作空间。支持通过标签页、分屏终端、SFTP、代码片段、会话共享及 AI 辅助功能连接无限数量的服务器，所有功能集成于一个适用于 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的原生桌面应用中。个人用户可永久免费使用不含 AI 功能的版本，需要协作与 AI 功能的团队可选择经济实惠的付费方案。
products.description: ShellMate is a modern SSH workspace built for developers, system administrators, and DevOps teams. Connect to unlimited servers with tabs, split terminals, SFTP, snippets, session sharing, and AI-powered assistance, all in one native desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Free forever for individual users without AI features, with affordable plans for teams that need collaboration and AI.

products.name: Seller by Facebook
products.tagline: The easiest way to sell on Facebook Marketplace
products.summaryZh: 在Facebook Marketplace上销售的最简单方法
products.descriptionZh: Seller 是一款专为 Facebook Marketplace 卖家设计的应用，帮助管理商品列表、与买家沟通并拓展销售业务。借助 AI 快速创建商品列表，在统一收件箱中管理对话，跟踪库存，并了解销售表现——一切尽在掌握。
products.description: Seller is a dedicated app for Facebook Marketplace sellers to manage listings, connect with buyers, and grow their selling business. Create listings faster with AI, manage conversations in one inbox, track inventory, and understand your performance — all from one place.

products.name: Velane
products.tagline: Cloud for your AI Agent's tools and functions
products.summaryZh: AI Agent工具与功能的云端支持
products.descriptionZh: Velane 是您AI Agent工具与功能的统一平台。它以Agent为优先，完全由您的AI Agent（Claude、Codex、Cursor等）自主控制。平台具备：1. 代码沙箱（零冷启动） 2. 版本控制 3. 环境管理（开发、预发布、生产） 4. 800+集成（可替代您的iPaaS）
products.description: Velane is the one platform for your AI Agent's tools and function. It is agent first, and fully controlled by your AI Agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor,..) It has: 1. Code Sandbox (with 0 cold start) 2. Version Control 3. Enviroments (dev, staging, prod) 4. 800+ Integrations (it replaces your iPaaS)

products.name: ADE
products.tagline: All your coding agents, synced everywhere, free forever
products.summaryZh: 你的所有编程助手，随处同步，永久免费。
products.descriptionZh: 使用您已付费的任何编程订阅，在一个同步的应用程序中运行，支持网页、桌面、终端和移动端。所有聊天记录在所有界面间保持同步。从笔记本电脑运行代理，晚餐时在手机上继续对话，之后只需使用网页客户端即可在另一台电脑上完成。所有订阅，集中一处。完全免费且开源！
products.description: Use any coding subscription you already pay for, in one synced app that runs on web, desktop, terminal, and mobile. All your chats stay synced between all ade surfaces. Run agents from your laptop, continue the conversation from your phone at dinner, then later finish it off from another computer by simply using the web client. All subs, all in one place. Fully free and open source!

products.name: Speech To Markdown
products.tagline: Harness local AI for notes
products.summaryZh: 利用本地AI处理笔记
products.descriptionZh: 一款免费的macOS和iOS应用，利用本地LLM将你的语音转换为结构化Markdown。支持全局听写（快捷键⌘⌥]），内置实时Markdown编辑器，可随时通过LLM修正内容。无需云端，无需API密钥——所有数据均不离开你的Mac。
products.description: A free macOS and iOS app that turns your voice into structured markdown using local LLM. Global dictation anywhere with ⌘⌥], live markdown editor with on-the-fly fix with LLM. No cloud, no API keys — nothing leaves your Mac.

products.name: Banquish — Make the web your workspace
products.tagline: Clip living pieces of the web onto one canvas
products.summaryZh: 将网页上的零散内容剪贴到一张画布上
products.descriptionZh: Banquish 是一款 Mac 应用，能将任意网站转化为工作空间。将所需内容拖拽至同一画布，保持实时更新，并让智能代理代为处理琐事。
products.description: Banquish is a Mac app that turns any website into a workspace. Pull the pieces you need onto one canvas, keep them live, and let an agent run the errands.

products.name: ClipStudios.AI
products.tagline: 15+ AI video models, one subscription — credits roll over
products.summaryZh: 15+ 款 AI 视频模型，一次订阅——积分可累积
products.descriptionZh: ClipStudios.AI 将15+款AI视频模型——Kling 2.6/3.0、Veo 3.1、Runway、Seedance、Wan——整合至统一的积分制订阅中。编写提示词、选择模型、生成视频。每段视频在创建时均带有C2PA签名（官方C2PA贡献者成员）。在ClipStudios中进行的编辑可保留该签名；第三方工具目前可能无法保留——基于符合GDPR标准的欧盟基础设施实现可验证溯源。同时包含脚本工作室、语音工作室、视频工具。提供免费套餐。付费方案起价20欧元/月。
products.description: ClipStudios.AI brings 15+ AI video models — Kling 2.6/3.0, Veo 3.1, Runway, Seedance, Wan — into one credit-based subscription. Write a prompt, pick a model, get a video. Every video is C2PA-signed at creation (official C2PA Contributor Member). Edits made in ClipStudios preserve that signature; third-party tools may not yet — verifiable provenance on GDPR-native EU infrastructure. Also includes Script Studio, Voice Studio, Video Tools. Free tier available. Paid plans from €20/month.

products.name: Drifty - Context Aware AI Time Tracker
products.tagline: Bring Visibility to your Focus
products.summaryZh: 让焦点清晰可见
products.descriptionZh: Drifty 是一款适用于 Mac 的 AI 时间追踪工具，能清晰展示你的工作日实际去向。无需计时器或手动记录，即可自动追踪工作。AI 能理解你活动背后的上下文，区分专注与分心，可视化你的每日工作流，并帮助你了解自己的注意力模式。需要一点帮助保持专注？Drifty 能检测到持续的分心状态，并温和地提醒你回到工作。为保护隐私，它可在本地运行，同时提供云端使用选项。
products.description: Drifty is an AI time tracker for Mac that shows where your workday actually goes. Automatically track your work with no timers or manual tracking. AI understands the context behind your activity, separates focus from distraction, visualizes your daily workflow, and helps you understand your attention patterns. Need a little help staying focused? Drifty detects sustained distractions and gently nudges you back to work. Runs locally for privacy, with the option to use the cloud when you want.

products.name: Fund Momentum
products.tagline: Live GP intelligence for 970+ actively deploying VC funds
products.summaryZh: 970+家活跃风投基金的实时GP情报
products.descriptionZh: 大多数VC数据库都是静态快照。Fund Momentum追踪970+家正在活跃部署的基金，并提供实时GP情报。- GP信号档案——主题标签、看涨/逆向信号、创始人行动指南- MCP服务器——连接Claude或Cursor，用自然语言查询基金- FM15——基于创始人契合度而非AUM的排名专为厌倦向已停止部署的基金推销的创始人打造。
products.description: Most VC databases are static snapshots. Fund Momentum tracks 970+ actively deploying funds with live GP intelligence. - GP Signal Profiles — thesis tags, bullish/contrarian signals, Founder Dos & Don'ts - MCP Server — connect Claude or Cursor, query funds in plain language - FM15 — ranking scored on founder alignment, not AUM Built for founders tired of pitching funds that stopped deploying.

products.name: DockAMP Webstack Manager for Docker
products.tagline: Web interface to manage Apache/Nginx, PHP, DB containers
products.summaryZh: 管理Apache/Nginx、PHP、数据库容器的Web界面
products.descriptionZh: DockAMP 是一个带有响应式 Web 界面的 Docker 镜像，用于管理 Docker 中的官方 Apache/Nginx、PHP、MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL 及代理容器。
products.description: DockAMP is a Docker image with a responsive web interface to manage official Apache/Nginx, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB/PostgeSQL and proxy containers in Docker.

products.name: Browser FX:
products.tagline: Transform your web audio with real-time effects
products.summaryZh: 实时效果，重塑你的网页音频体验
products.descriptionZh: Browser FX 通过实时专业音频效果，重塑你的网页音频体验。捕捉任意标签页的音频，在深色简洁界面中用工作室级旋钮进行塑造，配备音频响应式声波可视化器，甚至支持通过 MIDI 控制器进行手动操控。
products.description: Browser FX transforms your web audio experience with real-time professional audio effects. Capture any tab's audio and shape it with studio-style knobs in a sleek dark interface, complete with an audio-reactive cymatic visualizer, and even hands-on control from your MIDI controller.
